questions: The namespace of the second lemma. The dispatch names it Causal.E0LM.LocZplus.chronalFutureNeighbours, the namespace of the hoisted E0LM.LocZplus, so it sits in the ETT-layer module under a model-named namespace. I took the dispatched name, which also makes `h.chronalFutureNeighbours` work for `h : E0LM.LocZplus D`. A rename of the E0LM family is the separate question CausallyPlainLocZ's SCOPE already records.

The optional hoist of curveOn_symm. I took it, because it is the only way Flat.curveOn_chart_symm can cite: its statement covers any relation family, which the ≪-only chronalCurveOn_symm_image does not. Its cost is the curation line for cor:massA_cac. Without it, MassiveManifold and CauchyComplete would each keep a proof of the same statement.
